_comment: Test-only Firebase config. The real firebase.json keeps its multi-bucket storage array (needed for `firebase deploy --only storage`), which the emulator can't resolve without a deploy target. This file uses object-form storage so `firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.emulator.json` can start the Storage emulator for the rules tests (functions/test/rules/**). Rules paths are the same files, resolved relative to the repo root.
